findings.title: Timeline can display an impossible negative session duration
findings.what: formatDuration subtracts start from end but, unlike formatDelta, never rejects a negative result. For example, startIso="2026-01-01T00:00:01Z" and endIso="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" produce "-1.0s", which is then presented as the session Duration statistic.
findings.fix: After calculating diffMs, return the unavailable marker when diffMs < 0, matching the defensive treatment already used by formatDelta; add a focused regression test for reversed timestamps.
findings.acceptance: A timeline whose endTime precedes startTime renders Duration as "—" (or another explicit invalid-data marker), while valid millisecond, second, minute, and hour durations retain their current output; an automated component or formatter test covers the reversed-timestamp case.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the negative-value path at src/components/SessionTimeline.tsx:102-112 and its direct UI use at src/components/SessionTimeline.tsx:550-564. The related baseline parser merely assigns the first and last entry timestamps and does not establish or enforce monotonic ordering, so it does not eliminate the case.
